title: Barber Hill stock
description: Tan-weathering, light brown, fine to coarse grained alkali syenite. (114+/- 2 Ma (Armstrong and Stump, 1971; McHone and McHone, 1999)). Stock is cut by alkalic dikes

title: Stony Point Formation
description: Mud brown-weathering, very fine grained, dark gray shale with interbedded limestone and silty dolomite; gradational contact with underlying Ogf; hornfels at contact with Barber Hill stock. Stony Point and Iberville Formations were not mapped separately in the Charlotte area; all shales were calcareous

title: Glens Falls Formation
description: Gray-weathering, fine grained, thin bedded, fossiliferous, gray, limestone with shaley interbeds; contact with Osp is gradational with percent of shale beds increasing as the contact is approached

title: Orwell Formation
description: Massively bedded, light gray-weathering, fossiliferous gray limestone

title: Chazy Group
description: Light gray-weathering, fine grained, fossiliferous gray limestone; fabric selective dolomitization produces a "chicken wire" appearance on outcrop surface

title: Chipman Formation, Bridport Member
description: Buff to light orange-weathering, thickly bedded to massive dolostone; rectangular, steeply dipping fracture pattern give outcrops a distinctive appearance

title: Bascom Formation
description: Interbedded limestone and dolostone; sandy dolostone beds produce a characteristic ribbed appearance in weathered outcrops

title: Tribes Hill Formation
description: Gray weathering, fine to medium grained, light gray dolostone breccia, sandy laminated dolostone, and massive dolostone; chert nodules common. The base of Oth is defined following Landing et.al. (2003) as a debris flow composed of imbricated cross-bedded dolomitic sandstone fragments on Thompson's Point

title: Little Falls Formation
description: Gray-weathering, fine to medium grained, light gray dolostone breccia and massive dolostone; chert nodules common

title: Middle Proterozoic metamorphic rocks exposed in New York
Cutting Formation
description: Gray-weathering, thick bedded to massive, fine to medium grained, equigranular gray dolostone

title: Shelburne Formation
description: White-weathering, mottled gray and white, fine to very fine grained gray limestone and white marble; commonly with thin (<1mm) reticulated rusty-weathering dolomite lines throughout; locally karstic

title: Clarendon Springs Formation
description: Tan-weathering, massive, cream to light gray dolostone

title: Danby Formation
description: Orange and punky-weathering, thin to thick bedded, fine to medium grained, gray pebbly quartzite, massive, light gray, vitreous quartzite, and laminated sandy dolomite; cross-beds are common. Contact with Cw is gradational over approximately 20 meters

title: Winooski Formation
description: Buff-weathering, massive to thick bedded, fine-grained, gray to pink dolostone; interbedded with sandy, laminated dolostone +/- cross-beds; interbedded over approximately 20 meters with Cm at base; contact with Cda is gradational

title: Monkton Formation
description: Purplish brown-weathering, fine to medium grained, dark red to white, thin (1 - 10 cm) bedded quartzite with interbedded shale and dolostone; mud cracks and ripple marks occur along bedding planes; upper contact with Cw is by interbedding across approximately 20 meters of thickness

title: Monkton Formation, Dolostone member
description: Buff-weathering pink to gray dolostone member of the Monkton Fm
